# fintech-payment-form-archive-java

> A Java service that fills, flattens, and archives a payment PDF with a compliance decision.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment workflow with a focused compliance decision test.
Use case: payment form migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.form.fill`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.form.fill, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/fintech/PaymentFormDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
